biggest_catch: This offer EXPIRES September 25, 2026 at 9PM EST — and even then the account must stay open a minimum of 90 days before the $450 can be paid.
catches: Open a new FirstView Checking account between 08/03/2026 and 9PM EST 09/25/2026.
Applicant must be a new First Horizon checking client: no consumer checking account with First Horizon in the last 24 months.
Applicant must reside in a state where a First Horizon banking center is present.

Make qualifying direct deposits totaling at least $2,000 within 90 days of account opening — qualifying = recurring electronic deposits of payroll, pension, or Social Security; person-to-person, bank-to-bank, Zelle, and internet payment transfers do NOT qualify.
Opening deposit must be new funds from a financial institution other than First Horizon or its affiliates; $50 minimum opening deposit required.
The checking account must be open for a minimum of 90 days; bonus only paid to open, active accounts with a positive balance.

The $700 figure requires an additional $250 savings tier: open a new Traditional Savings account the same business day, deposit $3,000+ in new funds within 30 days, and maintain a $3,000+ daily collected balance for 90 days.
